links.source_location: publishes to GitHub Packages on release
builds and deploys javadoc and test results
The build uses a Java 25 toolchain and compiles to Java 17 bytecode
The OWASP dependency check plugin fails the build at CVSS >= 7
demo module is a Spring Boot application
CredentialsProviderService is a @Scheduled Spring service that polls two files from a Kubernetes-mounted directory
it calls setCredential(username, password) on every registered UpdatableCredential<String> bean
On update it swaps the immutable Credentials object and calls softEvictConnections()
Oracle UCP ... refreshes the connection pool
calls setUser()/setPassword() and refreshConnectionPool() on the Oracle UCP PoolDataSource
HikariDataSourceConfig must set the HikariCredentialsProvider on the config before creating the HikariDataSource
Spring Boot and Spring Cloud versions are coupled
External Secrets Operator is a secrets manager
HashiCorp Vault is a secrets manager
Seamless Rotation pattern applies to both HikariCP and UCP
The library uses a publisher-subscriber pattern to notify connection pools when credentials change
Seamless Rotation: New connections use updated credentials while existing connections continue
